title: strings.json holds 6 false rows: five user-facing claims contradict the production symbol that decides them
claim: In the tree under test, six strings.json sentences are contradicted by the production code deciding them: loose birch is not 0.60 of packed (wood_fuel), a flow sensor in L/min is read at 1/60 of its value (const.FLOW_UNIT_TO_KG_S), a fresh-water station carries 150 L of potable water not 0 (const.COMBI_TANK_PRESETS), Observe duty mode reaches the pump write (pump_arbiter._arbitrate), and the return-target off gate is 30 degC not 20 degC (pump_arbiter._gate_floor_c, two sentences).
mechanism: The text states the shipped behaviour; the production symbol each sentence describes delivers a different value. Per row (ledger.tsv, verdict false): #538b900c1b wood_packing (birch loose/packed=1.667, pine and mixed 0.600); #25d4327206 flow units (FLOW_UNIT_TO_KG_S['L/min']=0.998/3600, so 10 L/min x 5 K reads 0.058 kW instead of 3.48 kW); #60b9412b58 '0 for a fresh-water station' (external_station potable_volume_l=150.0); #b6c5358b63 'Observe writes none either' (one _command, one _adopt and one night-schedule write per observe pass); #3102a60501 and #7a9d1fff5d '20 degC for a return target' (_as_target adds RETURN_SUPPLY_OFFSET_K for a return unit, so _gate_floor_c returns 30.0 and the W35 hold 40.0).

evidence.machine: box B2 (light seat), Linux 6.18 x86_64, CPython 3.14.7 (venv-ci), PYTHONPATH=tests/hastub
evidence.contention_note: shared box during the fan-out (load1 6.9-7.5); a count, contention-immune

perturbation.change: ledger.py --perturb: the five one-line production edits of probes.py --perturb applied in memory (birch row {packed:1900, loose:1140}; 'L/min': WATER_KG_PER_L/60.0; external_station CombiTankPreset(0.75, 0.0); 'if mode != DUTY_CONTROL or _pump_off(inp, held): return' in _arbitrate; 'supply_c - RETURN_SUPPLY_OFFSET_K' in _as_target)

metric_definition: Ledger rows of strings.json whose executed probe of the deciding production symbol contradicts the sentence (text_ledger verdict false).
phenomenon_property: Every numeric or behavioural claim a strings.json sentence makes equals what the production symbol deciding it delivers.
seam_rule: PYTHONPATH=tests/hastub $HOME/venv-ci/bin/python3 dev/audit/rounds/round11/D6/s2/ledger.py  # prints each false row; per mechanism: PYTHONPATH=tests/hastub $HOME/venv-ci/bin/python3 dev/audit/rounds/round11/D6/s2/probes.py --probe {wood_packing_ratio,flow_unit_lmin,station_potable,observe_writes,return_gate}
proposed_fix_scope: The text is the documented intent in all five; the fix is production (five one-line edits, the perturbation's), each owned by its seam's seat (leads to D2-s1, D8-s1, D1-s1); translations/*.json carry the same sentences and need no change once production matches.
